title: aeat: MisPagos and SRAF agreements ignore the representation switch
blocker: AEAT officially documents MisPagos as own-name only. The separate SRAF representative route binds the requested debtor, but the authenticated search refused the in-scope entity with known agreements. No matching in-scope grant for this service has been established.
unblock: Provide an in-scope taxpayer with a current GENERALLEY58 or RB01011 power for the acting certificate and an existing SRAF agreement, then verify the represented list and detail.
notes: Observed 2026-11-18 with Christian 76048463K acting for AJN E67686287 (census representative): after OVCT-CXEW/DialogoRepresentacion the session header shows AJN, and Mis Expedientes, SCEJ declarations and SCGI informativas answer for AJN, but MisPagos and SRAF SolAccionW?fAccion=petic&fFigura=obli still list Christian's own payments and agreements (fnif ignored too). aeat pagos now refuses a non-holder NIF; aeat deudas skips agreements with agreementsNote. Smallest next step: find the SRAF/MisPagos parameter for a represented obligado, or keep the refusal.

2026-11-27: The official Aplazamientos menu publishes SolAccionW with fAccion=petic and fFigura=repre. Live DialogoRepresentacion led to a SRAF search with fAccion=consulta, fFigura=repre, nifdeudor and nifrepre bound to the intended identities. For the in-scope entity with independently verified agreements, the read-only search returned HTTP 200 with the explicit message El titular del certificado no está autorizado a esta consulta. The header selection is therefore insufficient evidence of a usable SRAF grant. The received-powers list contained one confirmed, current GENERALLEY58 grant outside the identified approved holder set. Sources: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/recaudacion/aplazamientos-fraccionamientos/aplazamiento-fraccionamiento-deudas/gestiones.html and https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/ayuda/consultas-informaticas/pago-impuestos-deudas-tasas-ayuda-tecnica/aplazamiento-fraccionamiento-deudas/gestion-aplazamientos-fraccionamientos.html.

2026-11-27: Reconciled the received GENERALLEY58 grant against all eight previously authorized certificate identities; none matched. A second in-scope company also reached the bound representative form without yielding a recognizable agreement list. Neither response is accepted as an empty account.
